note: Curated waypoint descriptions, keyed by the stable ids in data/waypoint-ids.json. Applied by scripts/build-trails.ts (overriding any description from the GPX source) and uploadable to the comments API with scripts/upload-descriptions.ts. Listed in walking order from Mundaring Weir to Northam. Waypoints without an entry keep their hand-reviewed GPX text. Sources for each fact: plans/waypoint-description-sources.md.

descriptions.name: Mundaring
descriptions.description: Perth Hills town on the track, with supermarkets, a bakery and cafes, and the Mundaring Visitor Centre on the Great Eastern Highway. From Mundaring Weir to Clackline the track follows the formation of the old Eastern Railway.

descriptions.name: Clackline
descriptions.description: Small town with a post office, where the track leaves the old Eastern Railway formation. From here to Northam it follows the route of C. Y. O'Connor's Goldfields water pipeline.

descriptions.name: Northam (1 km east)
descriptions.description: End of the track at the Avon River, on the northern side of the Poole Street Bridge on the west side of Northam. Northam, about 1 km east, has supermarkets, a post office and other services.
